title: Adult & child choking
tldr: If someone cannot speak, breathe or cough effectively, call emergency services. For a responsive adult or child, give 5 back blows followed by 5 abdominal thrusts, repeating until the blockage clears or they become unresponsive. Use chest thrusts when pregnant or when you cannot encircle the abdomen.
steps: If the person can cough effectively, encourage coughing and watch closely.
Send someone to call emergency services, or use speakerphone without delaying care.
Lean them forward for 5 back blows between shoulder blades, then give 5 abdominal thrusts; follow dispatcher guidance.
Lower them safely and start CPR as directed. Remove only a clearly visible object; never blindly sweep the mouth.
next: Get medical assessment after thrusts or persistent symptoms. Learn separate infant choking care.
watch: Do not use abdominal thrusts on an infant under one year; infant care uses back blows and chest thrusts.
